Alger, 29 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 29, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Télécom is strengthening the availability of its customer service to meet subscribers' requests.
Algérie Télécom informe ses clients de l: Algérie Télécom informs its customers of the extended availability of its customer service team. The latter can be reached every day of the week, including weekends, from 8:00 AM until midnight. The objective is to support users and answer all their questions regarding the operator's offers and services. Customers can contact customer service by phone by dialing 12 (short number) or 021 21 12 12 (general number). This measure aims to improve the customer experience and guarantee continuous assistance.
